meaning:
ὕπαρξις, -εως, ἡ
(ὑπάρχω), [in LXX for רְכוּשׁ, הוֹן, etc. ;]
1. subsistence, existence (Arist., al.).
2. In late writers, = τὰ ὑπάρχοντα, substance, property: Heb.10:34; pl., Act.2:45.†
(AS)
